text.p: Lucent Technologies Inc said Thursday it expects second-quarter earnings of $55-$65 million, or $0.09-$0.10 per share.
Analysts' consensus estimate is $0.04 per share, according to First Call.
Revenues for the quarter are expected to be about $5.1 billion, said Donald Peterson, Lucent chief financial officer and executive vice president.
Petersen offered the estimates to analysts in a morning conference call, Lucent said.
For the 1996 second quarter, Lucent posted a net loss of $103 million, or $0.16 per share, on a pro forma basis, on revenues of $4.58 billion.
Petersen said the second quarter results will include increased revenue from Lucent's Personal Communications Services (PCS) contracts.

He said sales of high-margin products such as software and wireless communications systems were strong in the quarter. Cost-cutting measures and improvements in international operations also boosted results, he said.
Lucent, the telecommunications equipment company that was spun off from AT&T Corp, said it completes its first full year as a public company tomorrow.
